name: Decay
tagline: The board forgets. Old clues fade after every guess.
description: A daily five-letter word game where earlier clues fade from the board after every guess. Six tries, and your memory is the real opponent.

name: Reverse
tagline: The bot is solving. You give the feedback. Lie, but stay consistent.
description: Roles reversed: a minimax bot guesses the word and you score it. Lie as much as you like, as long as some real word still fits. Keep it guessing.

name: Suspect
tagline: One tile in every row is lying. Solve it, then catch the liars.
description: A daily word game where exactly one tile in every row lies. Solve the word in eight guesses and accuse the liars for bonus glory.

name: Warmer
tagline: Guess any word. Get told how close it is in meaning.
description: Guess any word and see where it ranks out of 30,000 by closeness in meaning. Get warmer until you find the secret word.

name: Bridge
tagline: Get from one word to another in as few close hops as you can.
description: Build a chain of related words from a start word to an end word. Every hop must be close in meaning. Beat the bot's par.

name: Missing
tagline: One word is missing from six sentences. Each miss shows another.
description: Six sentences share one missing word. Start with the vaguest; every miss reveals a sharper clue. How few do you need?

name: Define
tagline: A definition, one fragment at a time. Name the word.
description: A dictionary definition arrives one fragment at a time, vaguest first. Name the word in as few pieces as you can.

name: Before/After
tagline: Name the secret moment in history. Each guess says before or after.
description: A daily history puzzle. Guess any event and learn if the secret one came before or after, how far apart, and whether it shares a theme. Seven guesses.
